issues.on_page: Schedules 1-2 print both 'Actual on GAAP Basis' and 'Actual on Budgetary Basis' columns
issues.issue: Detail uses the budgetary-basis actuals, so it does not tie to the GAAP statement on p2 (e.g. Debt Service Special Assessments 598,406 and Net Capital Outlay 942,014 vs 801,841; General Fund Engineering 13,154 vs 33,436). This is a defensible reading of 'Actual column' and the notes say so, but a person should confirm which actual column the pipeline wants.

Nothing in the trimmed pages explains this line. Recording it as 'other' with a review flag is allowed, but it is 7% of governmental revenue and may be special assessment or developer collections. The same applies to detail[20] (119,928, p5).

Change in Payables is a non-cash accrual printed under Other Financing Sources (Uses). Folding it into other_financing follows the page, but it could go in adjustments instead. The arithmetic is correct and it is marked computed.
